|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">意志の強いオルデランのプリンセス。史上最年少の帝国元老院議員。外交特権を使って反乱軍のスパイをする。ラルティアの反乱活動を支援した。天性のリーダー。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Leia Organa.

'''Card text:''' On the Death Star, Rebels at the same site as her are power +1. Her diplomatic immunity gives her immunity to attrition less than 2.

'''Lore:''' A strong-willed princess of Alderaan and the youngest member of the Imperial Senate in history. She uses diplomatic immunity to spy for the Rebels. She supported Rebel activity on Ralltiir. A natural leader.
